Please fill in the fields below to help build a comprehensive community compatibility matrix. Both English and Portuguese submissions are welcome.

- **Model:** (e.g. Civic, CR-V, Accord)

- **Trim Level:** (e.g. EXL, Touring, Sport, LX)

## Head Unit Data

How to identify these fields: see [`docs/en/03-finding-your-firmware.md`](../../docs/en/03-finding-your-firmware.md)

- **DA Version (`ro.build.id`):** (e.g. `1.F187.16`)
- **ROM Type (`custom_rom.type`):** (e.g. `0040`)
- **Device (`ro.product.device`):**
- **Model (`ro.product.model`):**
- **Build Tags (`ro.build.tags`):**
- **Display Resolution:** (e.g. 800×480)
- **Cold Boot Combination:** (e.g. Hold `AUDIO` for 5s)
